fennec: A fennec fox standing on all four legs, a very small pale sandy desert fox with ENORMOUS triangular ears far too large for its head, each ear nearly as long as its whole face, a tiny delicate body, slender legs, a small pointed muzzle and a bushy black-tipped tail
croc_j: A baby crocodile hatchling lying low with its belly close to the ground, a tiny crocodilian with a LONG FLAT ARMOURED SNOUT lined with small teeth, heavy scaly hide with bony ridged scutes down its back, short splayed legs and a long thick tail. A miniature crocodile, not a gecko, not a short-faced lizard
hornbill: A hornbill perched on a branch, a large black and white bird with an enormous curved bill topped by a HOLLOW HORNY CASQUE RIDGE running along the upper mandible, a long tail and bare skin around the eye. The casque on top of the bill is essential. Not a toucan
sandcat: A sand cat standing on all four legs, a small stocky pale sandy desert cat with a BROAD FLAT WIDE HEAD and EARS SET LOW AND WIDE ON THE SIDES OF THE HEAD pointing outward rather than standing upright on top, dense pale fur, short legs and a dark-ringed tail
arcticfox: An arctic fox standing on all four legs in thick PURE WHITE winter fur, a small compact fox with a short rounded muzzle, small rounded ears, short legs and an extremely thick bushy white tail. Entirely white, never dark or charcoal
manedwolf_j: A maned wolf pup standing on all four legs, a young canid with soft REDDISH-TAWNY fur, oversized ears, a dark muzzle and dark stockings on its legs which are already long for its body. Reddish-orange, not black
manedwolf: A maned wolf standing on all four legs, a tall slender fox-red canid on EXTREMELY LONG THIN BLACK LEGS like stilts that carry its body very high off the ground, with a long muzzle, very large upright ears and a dark mane over the neck and shoulders. The stilt legs are the defining feature and far longer than any fox
cheetah_j: A cheetah cub standing on all four legs, a spotted cub with a THICK SILVER-GREY MANTLE OF LONG FUR running down its neck, shoulders and back like a cape, black tear stripes running from each eye to the mouth, a small round head and long legs
thunderbird: A colossal mythic thunderbird, a vast eagle-like bird of prey with storm-dark blue-grey plumage, immense outstretched feathered wings, crackling pale electric light along the wing edges, a fierce noble eagle head with a hooked beak and heavy taloned feet. A great bird, not a demon and not a bat
pallascat: A Pallas's cat sitting, an extremely stocky small wildcat made to look ROUND AND FAT by a very dense long shaggy grey coat, with a WIDE FLAT FACE, a flat-topped head, SMALL LOW-SET ROUNDED EARS on the sides of the head, and a short thick tail
bonobo: A bonobo walking on all fours on its knuckles, a slender black ape with long arms, a black face with pink lips and hair parted on the crown. Quadrupedal knuckle-walking posture, absolutely NOT standing upright like a human
siamang: A siamang hanging by one long arm from a branch, a large black gibbon with extremely long arms and shaggy black fur, and a LARGE INFLATED GREY THROAT SAC ballooning out beneath its chin
mandrill: A mandrill walking on all four legs, a large heavy monkey with a striking face: a BRIGHT RED STRIPE down the centre of the muzzle flanked by RAISED RIBBED BLUE CHEEK RIDGES, a golden-yellow beard, an olive-brown body and a short stub tail
gelada: A gelada baboon sitting, a heavy brown monkey with a long thick cape of brown fur over its shoulders, a BARE BRIGHT RED HOURGLASS PATCH OF SKIN ON ITS CHEST, a short muzzle and a tufted tail
macaque: A Japanese macaque sitting on all fours, a stocky monkey with thick pale grey-brown fur, a BARE BRIGHT RED FACE and red rump, and a very short stub tail
proboscis: A proboscis monkey sitting on a branch, a large orange-brown monkey with a HUGE PENDULOUS DROOPING FLESHY NOSE hanging down over its mouth, a large round POT BELLY, pale grey limbs and a long pale tail
vervet: A vervet monkey standing on all four legs, a small slender monkey with grizzled GREY-GREEN fur, a BLACK FACE framed by a WHITE BROW BAND and white cheek tufts, pale underparts and a long tail
wallaby: A wallaby standing upright on its hind legs, a SMALL COMPACT kangaroo-like marsupial noticeably smaller and stockier than a kangaroo, with shorter legs, a shorter blunter face, grey-brown fur, small forepaws held at its chest and a thick tapering tail
tasdevil: A Tasmanian devil standing on four short legs, a squat black dog-sized marsupial with a VERY LARGE BROAD HEAD and heavy jaws, a thick neck, a white band across its chest, short legs and a stout tail. Low and squat, not bear-like
quoll: A spotted quoll standing on all four legs, a small slender cat-sized carnivorous marsupial with a pointed pink nose, large rounded ears, rich brown fur covered in distinct WHITE SPOTS across the back AND along the tail, and a long bushy tail
muskox: A muskox standing on all four legs, a massive shaggy arctic bovid whose extremely long dark brown coat hangs almost to the ground like a skirt, with a low broad head, a humped shoulder, and heavy pale horns that meet in a SOLID BOSS ACROSS THE FOREHEAD then sweep down beside the face and hook up at the tips
moose: A moose standing on all four legs, an enormous long-legged dark brown deer with a very long heavy drooping muzzle, a PRONOUNCED HUMPED SHOULDER, a dangling flap of skin called the bell hanging beneath its throat, and broad flat palmate antlers
reindeer: A reindeer standing on all four legs, a stocky arctic deer with a thick pale brown and cream coat, a shaggy white neck ruff, broad splayed hooves, and LARGE SWEEPING ANTLERS carrying a distinctive forward-pointing brow shovel over the face
dikdik: A dik-dik standing on all four legs, a TINY antelope barely knee high with enormous dark eyes, a LONG MOBILE ELONGATED FLEXIBLE SNOUT like a short trunk, a tuft of hair on its forehead, very thin delicate legs and tiny straight spike horns
kudu: A greater kudu standing on all four legs, a tall grey-brown antelope with narrow WHITE VERTICAL STRIPES down its flanks, a white chevron between the eyes, very large rounded ears, and MAGNIFICENT ENORMOUS SPIRALLING CORKSCREW HORNS sweeping high above its head through two or three full open twists
nyala: A male nyala standing on all four legs, a shaggy dark slate-brown antelope with narrow white vertical stripes, a long fringe of hair hanging beneath its throat and belly, BRIGHT ORANGE-TAN LOWER LEGS, and lyre-shaped spiralling horns tipped with cream
saiga: A saiga antelope standing on all four legs, a pale sandy antelope with an extraordinary BULBOUS SWOLLEN DROOPING TUBULAR NOSE hanging down over its mouth like a short trunk with downward-facing nostrils, and ribbed translucent amber horns. The huge swollen nose is the defining feature
markhor: A markhor standing on all four legs, a large wild goat with a long shaggy white and grey coat, a heavy fringe of beard hanging from its throat and chest, and TOWERING TIGHTLY CORKSCREWED SPIRAL HORNS twisting straight upward like two drill bits
vicuna: A vicuna standing on all four legs, a small slender wild camelid with fine pale cinnamon fur, a WHITE BIB of long fur on its chest, a long slim neck, large dark eyes and short pointed ears
whiterhino: A white rhinoceros standing on all four legs, a colossal grey rhino with a WIDE SQUARE FLAT-LIPPED GRAZING MOUTH, a pronounced hump on the back of its neck, a long front horn with a shorter second horn behind it, and thick smooth grey hide
blackrhino: A black rhinoceros standing on all four legs, a dark grey rhino with a POINTED PREHENSILE HOOKED UPPER LIP for browsing, two horns with the front one long and curved, a rounded back and thick folded grey hide
babirusa: A babirusa standing on all four legs, a strange nearly hairless grey wild pig with a barrel body and slender legs, the male carrying TWO PAIRS OF CURVING TUSKS, the upper pair growing straight UP THROUGH THE TOP OF THE SNOUT and curving back toward the forehead
asianelephant: An Asian elephant standing on all four legs, a large grey elephant with SMALL ROUNDED EARS, a twin-domed forehead, an ARCHED ROUNDED BACK, and a trunk ending in a single finger. Distinctly smaller ears than an African elephant
mammoth: A woolly mammoth standing on all four legs, an elephantine beast under a long shaggy reddish-brown coat, with a HIGH DOMED HEAD, a pronounced shoulder hump, small ears, and immense LONG CURVING SPIRALLING IVORY TUSKS crossing in front of it
leopardseal: A leopard seal lying on ice, a long sleek muscular seal with a SERPENTINE REPTILIAN HEAD on a long neck, a wide gape, a silver-grey back and a pale spotted throat, and long fore-flippers. A seal, not a lizard
weddellseal: A SINGLE Weddell seal lying alone on the ice, ONE plump rounded seal with a small round head, a short blunt muzzle with pale whiskers, a gently upturned mouth and a mottled silver-grey body. Only one animal in the frame
harpseal: An ADULT harp seal lying on ice, a silvery-grey seal with a BLACK FACE and a bold BLACK HARP-SHAPED WISHBONE MARKING ACROSS ITS BACK AND FLANKS. An adult, not a fluffy white pup
spermwhale: A sperm whale swimming, an enormous dark grey whale with a MASSIVE BLUNT SQUARE BOX-LIKE HEAD making up a third of its length, a narrow underslung lower jaw, wrinkled prune-like skin, small paddle flippers and a broad triangular fluke
flyingsquirrel: A flying squirrel gliding horizontally, a small squirrel with a loose FURRY FLAP OF SKIN stretched taut between its outstretched front and hind legs on each side forming a soft square furry glider edged with fur, huge round black eyes, and a broad flattened bushy tail trailing as a rudder. The gliding surface is furry skin, absolutely NOT feathered wings
nakedmolerat: A naked mole-rat lying flat along the floor of an earth tunnel, a small pink hairless sausage-shaped rodent with loose wrinkled saggy translucent skin, TINY PINPRICK EYES, no external ears, short stubby splayed legs, and two pairs of large flat chisel-like buck teeth projecting FORWARD outside its lips
degu: A degu sitting up on its haunches, a small brown rodent like a large gerbil with a rounded head, large dark eyes, rounded ears, and a LONG THIN MOSTLY BARE TAIL ending in a SMALL DARK TUFT AT THE VERY TIP ONLY. The tail is thin, not a thick brush
arctichare: An arctic hare crouched in snow, a large PURE WHITE hare with a compact rounded body, dense white fur, dark eyes, and short ears TIPPED WITH BLACK AT THE VERY TIPS ONLY. Entirely white apart from those black ear tips
whaleshark: A whale shark swimming, an enormous shark with a broad flattened head and a wide terminal mouth across its front, dark blue-grey skin scattered with PALE CREAM ROUND SPOTS AND FINE PALE STRIPES in an even natural pattern, and prominent ridges along the flanks. Natural scattered spots, absolutely NOT a checkerboard grid
baskingshark: A basking shark swimming with its mouth open, a huge slow grey shark with an ENORMOUS GAPING ROUND MOUTH lined with PALE FEATHERY GILL RAKERS AND NO VISIBLE TEETH, a pointed conical snout, and vast gill slits nearly encircling its head. A harmless filter feeder, not a toothy predator
nurseshark: A nurse shark resting on the seabed, a stocky brownish shark with a BROAD BLUNT ROUNDED HEAD, a small mouth on the underside with TWO FLESHY BARBELS hanging from the snout, tiny eyes and a long low tail. Mouth closed with no visible teeth
goblinshark: A goblin shark swimming, a flabby pale pink deep-sea shark with a LONG FLAT BLADE-LIKE SNOUT projecting far forward above its head and its NAIL-LIKE JAWS THRUST FORWARD AND OUT from beneath that snout, with small eyes and a soft body
frilledshark: A frilled shark swimming, a long brown EEL-LIKE shark with a slender serpentine body, a broad flattened head with a wide terminal mouth, and SIX PAIRS OF RUFFLED FRILLY GILL SLITS with feathery edges wrapped around its throat like a collar
greenlandshark: A Greenland shark swimming slowly, a massive sluggish dark grey-brown shark with a THICK HEAVY ROUNDED BODY, a short blunt rounded snout, very small eyes, small low fins and a broad heavy tail. Bulky and slow, not sleek
mantaray: A manta ray gliding, an enormous flat diamond-shaped ray with vast triangular pectoral wings, a WIDE TERMINAL MOUTH ACROSS THE FRONT OF ITS HEAD flanked by TWO FORWARD-POINTING ROLLED FLESHY CEPHALIC FINS like horns, dark above and white below, with a long thin whip tail. A living animal, not an aircraft
electricray: An electric ray resting on sand, a ray with a smooth ROUNDED CIRCULAR DISC BODY, small eyes set on top, a short thick fleshy tail bearing two small dorsal fins and a rounded tail fin, and mottled brown skin
oarfish: An oarfish swimming vertically, an immensely LONG RIBBON-LIKE SILVER FISH many times longer than it is deep, with a laterally compressed silvery body, a BRIGHT RED CREST OF LONG FIN RAYS running the entire length of its back and rising into a tall plume above its head, and long trailing red pelvic fins
sunfishmola: An ocean sunfish, a gigantic flattened DISC-SHAPED fish that ends abruptly with NO TAIL AT ALL, only a short frilled rudder flap where a tail would be, with a very tall triangular dorsal fin above and a matching anal fin below, a small eye and a small round mouth
weedyseadragon: A weedy seadragon, a slender seahorse relative with a long tubular snout and a thin elongated body ringed with bony bands, covered along its whole length in LEAF-SHAPED AND WEED-LIKE SKIN APPENDAGES, coloured reddish-orange with purple bands and yellow spots
moonjelly: A moon jelly, a translucent pale bluish-white SAUCER-SHAPED BELL with FOUR DISTINCT PALE HORSESHOE-SHAPED RINGS visible through the top, a dense fringe of very short fine tentacles around the rim and short frilly oral arms beneath. A soft translucent jellyfish
boxjelly: A box jellyfish, a translucent pale blue jellyfish with a TRANSPARENT CUBE-SHAPED BELL with softly rounded corners, and LONG FINE TRAILING TENTACLES hanging in bundles from its four lower corners. A living translucent animal, absolutely NOT a solid box or a container
mimicoctopus: A mimic octopus on the seabed, an octopus with a small pointed soft head, eyes raised on short stalks, and EIGHT LONG FLEXIBLE TAPERING ARMS boldly banded in brown and white stripes, the arms trailing and curling. A soft-bodied octopus, not a flat card or sheet
coconutcrab: A coconut crab, a gigantic heavy land crab with a thick domed carapace and IMMENSELY THICK POWERFUL LEGS built to carry great weight, one enormous heavy claw much larger than the other held raised, and long stalked eyes, in deep blue-purple and orange armour
fiddlercrab: A male fiddler crab on sand, a small square-bodied crab with ONE VASTLY OVERSIZED BRIGHTLY COLOURED CLAW nearly as large as its entire body held up in front of it, and the OTHER CLAW TINY by comparison, with eyes on long stalks. The extreme difference between the two claws is the whole point
harpyeagle: A harpy eagle perched, a massive powerful eagle with a pale grey head crowned by a DOUBLE CREST OF RAISED DARK FEATHERS standing up like two horns, a broad black chest band, white underparts, huge dark grey wings and ENORMOUS TALONS as thick as a human hand
harrier: A northern harrier flying low with its wings held in a shallow V, a slim long-winged long-tailed hawk with a BRIGHT WHITE PATCH ON ITS RUMP just above the tail and an OWL-LIKE FLAT FACIAL DISC around the eyes, brown above and streaked below
secretarybird: A secretary bird striding on the ground, a tall grey bird of prey on VERY LONG PINK LEGS with BLACK FEATHERED THIGHS like short trousers, an eagle-like hooked beak, bare orange skin around the eye, and a CREST OF LONG BLACK QUILL FEATHERS sticking out from the back of its head like a handful of pens
pelican: A pelican standing, a large white water bird with a HUGE LONG STRAIGHT BILL beneath which hangs an ENORMOUS ELASTIC THROAT POUCH of bare skin, a short thick neck, a heavy body and short legs with webbed feet
albatross: A wandering albatross in flight, an immense white seabird with EXTREMELY LONG NARROW STIFF WINGS held straight out and rigid, black upper wingtips, a white body and head, and a long heavy pale hooked bill. The wingspan is enormous relative to the body
kiwi: A kiwi standing on the ground, a rounded flightless brown bird the size of a chicken with shaggy hair-like brown plumage, NO VISIBLE WINGS OR TAIL, a small head, sturdy pale legs with large feet, and a VERY LONG SLENDER PALE DOWNCURVED BILL
potoo: A great potoo perched upright on a broken stump, a large grey nightbird with mottled bark-like grey and brown cryptic plumage, an ENORMOUS WIDE FROG-LIKE GAPING MOUTH and HUGE ROUND YELLOW EYES, head tilted up as it pretends to be part of the wood. Not an owl
caiman: A black caiman lying LOW AND FLAT with its belly on the ground and its legs splayed out to the sides, a large dark crocodilian with a long broad armoured snout, heavy bony scutes down its back and a long thick tail. Low-slung and sprawling, absolutely NOT standing tall on straight upright legs
rattlesnake: A rattlesnake coiled ready to strike, a heavy-bodied pit viper with a broad TRIANGULAR HEAD, dark diamond blotches down a tan back, and a SEGMENTED RATTLE OF PALE HORNY BUTTONS raised at the tip of its tail. The rattle is essential
goliathfrog: A goliath frog crouching, an ENORMOUS heavy frog the size of a cat, with a broad flat head, granular olive-green and brown skin, a pale yellowish belly, huge muscular hind legs and very large webbed feet
newt: A male great crested newt, a dark brown-black newt with warty skin, a BRIGHT ORANGE BELLY COVERED IN BOLD BLACK BLOTCHES, and a TALL JAGGED SAW-TOOTHED CREST running along its back and down its tail
tawnyfrogmouth: A tawny frogmouth perched upright on a branch, a stocky grey nightbird with mottled silver-grey bark-like plumage, a BROAD FLAT WIDE FROG-LIKE BEAK, stiff bristles above the bill and staring yellow eyes, sitting bolt upright pretending to be a broken branch. Not an owl
fancyrat: A fancy pet rat standing on all four legs, a domestic rat with a sleek brown and white coat, a blunt rounded muzzle, large round pink ears, bright dark eyes, delicate pink paws and a long pale bare tail
fancymouse: A fancy pet mouse standing on all four legs, a small domestic mouse with a smooth pale fawn coat, a pointed muzzle, very large round pink ears, shining black eyes and a long thin pink tail
potbellypig: A potbelly pig standing on four short legs, a small black pig with a DEEPLY SAGGING PENDULOUS BELLY hanging almost to the ground, a SWAYED DIPPED BACK, a short snub snout, small upright ears and very short legs
cow: A dairy cow standing on all four legs, a large black and white Holstein cow with irregular black patches over white, a deep barrel body, a LARGE PINK UDDER beneath, a broad muzzle and small horns
highlandcow: A Highland cow standing on all four legs, stocky ginger-orange cattle under an extremely LONG SHAGGY WAVY COAT, with a THICK FRINGE OF HAIR HANGING OVER ITS EYES and long upward-curving pale horns spreading wide
donkey: A donkey standing on all four legs, a sturdy grey donkey with a LARGE HEAD and VERY LONG UPRIGHT EARS, a short upright dark mane, a compact stocky body, short thick legs and a tufted tail
duck: A domestic white duck standing, a plump white farmyard duck with a broad flat ORANGE BILL, orange webbed feet, a rounded body and a short upcurled tail
devonrex: A Devon Rex cat sitting, a slender cat covered in a SHORT SOFT CURLY WAVY COAT, with ENORMOUS LOW-SET BAT-LIKE EARS, a small wedge-shaped face with high cheekbones and very large eyes. Curly-coated, absolutely NOT hairless
bordercollie: A border collie standing on all four legs, a medium herding dog in BLACK AND WHITE: black over the back and sides, a WHITE BLAZE up the muzzle and forehead, a broad WHITE COLLAR around the neck, a white chest, white feet and a white tail tip, with a bushy tail and alert ears
chihuahua: A chihuahua standing on all four legs, a TINY fawn dog with a ROUNDED APPLE-SHAPED HEAD, very large upright triangular ears, enormous round dark eyes, a short pointed muzzle, a small compact body and fine slender legs
eaglet: A bald eagle CHICK sitting in a stick nest, a fluffy nestling covered entirely in soft GREY-WHITE DOWN, with a large dark bill, dark eyes and stubby undeveloped wings. A downy chick: absolutely NO white adult head, NO brown adult plumage, NO yellow adult beak
flamingo_j: A juvenile flamingo standing, a young flamingo in DULL GREY-BROWN PLUMAGE just beginning to flush PALE PINK in patches, with a long neck held in a shallow curve, a pale downcurved bill with a dark tip, and long greyish-pink legs
molepup: A naked mole-rat pup, a tiny pink hairless newborn rodent with translucent wrinkled skin, EYES SEALED SHUT AS TINY CLOSED SLITS, no external ears, tiny stubby legs and small front teeth. Blind with closed eyes
molequeen: The naked mole-rat queen, a large pink hairless rodent with a long wrinkled sausage body noticeably LONGER AND FATTER than an ordinary mole-rat, TINY PINPRICK EYES, no external ears, stubby splayed legs and prominent chisel-like buck teeth
orca_c: A SINGLE orca calf swimming alone, one small killer whale with a glossy black back and white underside, its eye patches and flank patches a warm PEACH-ORANGE CREAM COLOUR rather than white, with a small rounded dorsal fin. Only one animal in the frame
narwhal_c: A SINGLE narwhal calf swimming alone, one small slate-grey mottled whale with a rounded blunt head, ABSOLUTELY NO TUSK, a smooth back with no dorsal fin and small rounded flippers. No tusk of any kind
bottlenose_c: A SINGLE bottlenose dolphin calf swimming alone, ONE small grey dolphin with a short stubby beak, a curved dorsal fin and faint pale vertical fetal fold lines along its flanks. Only ONE dolphin in the frame, no adult
asianelephant_c: A SINGLE Asian elephant calf standing alone, one small round grey baby elephant with an oversized head, SMALL ROUNDED EARS, NO TUSKS, sparse dark hair on its head and back, a short trunk and stubby legs. Clearly a baby
mammoth_c: A SINGLE woolly mammoth calf standing alone, one small shaggy reddish-brown baby mammoth thickly furred from birth, with a domed head, small ears, a short trunk and NO TUSKS AT ALL
kangaroo_j2: A red kangaroo joey, a very small young kangaroo with disproportionately LARGE EARS AND LARGE HIND FEET for its small body, a short blunt face, thin forelimbs held at its chest and a thin tail. Small and gangly, clearly a baby
wallaby_j: A SINGLE wallaby joey alone, ONE very small young wallaby with a rounded head, large ears, big dark eyes, soft grey-brown fur and oversized hind feet. One animal only, no adult in the frame
koala_j: A SINGLE koala joey alone, ONE small young koala with an oversized round head, huge fluffy round ears, a large black leathery spoon-shaped nose and soft grey fur, clinging to a branch. Only one koala in the frame
wombat_j: A SINGLE wombat joey alone, ONE small stocky young wombat with a broad blunt head, small rounded ears, small dark eyes, coarse brown fur and short powerful legs. One animal only
quokka_j: A SINGLE quokka joey alone, ONE small young quokka with a rounded head, small rounded ears, a short blunt muzzle, brown fur and its characteristic smiling mouth. One animal only
opossum_j: A SINGLE opossum joey alone, ONE small young Virginia opossum with a pointed pink snout, thin bare rounded ears, grizzled grey and white fur, pink feet and a long bare prehensile tail. One animal only, no litter
whiterhino_c: A SINGLE white rhinoceros calf alone, one small grey rhino calf with a WIDE SQUARE FLAT MOUTH, a smooth forehead and NO HORN AT ALL, only bare smooth skin where the horn will one day grow, with large ears and stubby legs
blackrhino_c: A SINGLE black rhinoceros calf alone, one small dark grey rhino calf with a POINTED HOOKED UPPER LIP and NO HORN AT ALL, only a smooth snout, with large rounded ears and short thick legs
bison_c: A SINGLE American bison calf alone, one small BRIGHT ORANGE-RED woolly calf, the colour known as a red dog, with a rounded body, short legs, small dark hooves, a short muzzle and NO SHOULDER HUMP YET
camel_c: A SINGLE camel calf alone, one small pale cream baby camel with a COMPLETELY FLAT SMOOTH BACK AND NO HUMP AT ALL, long gangly legs, a long neck, a soft rounded muzzle and large dark eyes with long lashes
walrus_c: A SINGLE walrus calf alone, one plump wrinkled cinnamon-brown young walrus with a broad blunt muzzle covered in stiff whiskers, NO TUSKS AT ALL, small eyes and short flippers
weddellseal_p: A SINGLE Weddell seal pup alone on ice, ONE fluffy silver-grey pup with a small round head, large dark eyes, a short muzzle with pale whiskers and soft woolly fur. Only one seal in the frame, no adult
vampirebat: A common vampire bat walking on the ground on its folded wings and hind legs, a small brown bat with a SHORT CONICAL SNOUT and a flat leafless nose pad, small pointed ears and sharp front teeth, its wings folded like forelimbs. A small bat, not a dragon
longnosedbat: A lesser long-nosed bat hovering at a flower, a small brown bat with a DISTINCTLY ELONGATED POINTED SNOUT, a small triangular noseleaf, large dark eyes, small ears and a LONG PROTRUDING BRUSH-TIPPED TONGUE reaching forward
fishingbat: A greater bulldog bat flying low over water with its hind feet lowered, a large reddish-brown bat with a BLUNT BULLDOG-LIKE MUZZLE with fleshy jowls and a split upper lip, and ENORMOUS LONG HOOKED CLAWS on its trailing hind feet
pallidbat: A pallid bat perched, a pale sandy-cream bat with VERY LARGE BROAD ROUNDED PINK EARS almost as long as its head, large dark eyes, a blunt pig-like snout and pale membranous wings folded at its sides
orchidbee: An orchid bee on a flower, a BRILLIANT METALLIC IRIDESCENT GREEN BEE: an insect with SIX jointed legs, a shining rounded metallic thorax and abdomen, two pairs of transparent veined wings, large compound eyes and long antennae. An insect, absolutely NOT humanoid, no human arms or legs, no upright posture
sealamprey: A sea lamprey, a long smooth EEL-LIKE JAWLESS FISH with a slender mottled grey-brown body, no paired fins, a row of seven small round gill holes behind the eye, and a large ROUND SUCKER MOUTH DISC RINGED WITH CONCENTRIC ROWS OF SMALL HORNY TEETH held open toward the viewer
pacifichagfish: A Pacific hagfish, a long slender pale grey-pink EEL-LIKE JAWLESS FISH with a soft tubular body, no fins except a low ridge along the tail, four pairs of short barbels around a slit-like mouth, tiny eyespots, and threads of slime
sundacolugo: A Sunda colugo gliding, a mammal with an ENORMOUS GLIDING MEMBRANE STRETCHED BETWEEN ALL FOUR LIMBS AND ALSO ENCLOSING THE TAIL to form one huge continuous kite-shaped surface reaching from the neck to the fingertips, the ankles and the very tip of the tail, with mottled grey-brown fur and a small head with large dark eyes
bristlenosepleco: A bristlenose pleco resting on a rock, a flattened dark mottled brown armoured catfish with a BROAD FLAT ROUND SUCKER MOUTH ON THE UNDERSIDE of its head, bony armour plates, a tall fan-shaped dorsal fin, and in the male a CLUSTER OF FLESHY BRANCHING BRISTLES ON THE SNOUT
christmastreeworm: A Christmas tree worm on coral, TWO BRIGHT SPIRAL FIR-TREE-SHAPED FEATHERY CROWNS rising side by side from a coral surface, each a perfect cone of tiny feathery radioles spiralling around a central axis in vivid colour, the worm's body hidden inside the coral. Two spiral cones on coral, absolutely not a figure
bobbitworm: A bobbit worm rising from the sand, a long IRIDESCENT SEGMENTED WORM with a banded rainbow metallic body, and at its head FIVE ANTENNAE and a pair of enormous SHARP SCISSOR-LIKE JAWS opened wide
horseshoecrab: A horseshoe crab seen FROM ABOVE, a smooth domed HORSESHOE-SHAPED BROWN CARAPACE like a helmet, a smaller hinged rear section edged with short spines, and a LONG RIGID POINTED SPIKE TAIL trailing straight out behind
tardigrade: A tardigrade water bear, a plump translucent pale barrel-shaped micro-animal with a CHUBBY SEGMENTED BODY, EIGHT SHORT STUBBY LEGS each ending in tiny claws, and a round tube-like mouth at the front. Eight stubby legs, plump and rounded
velvetworm: A velvet worm, a soft velvety caterpillar-like creature with a deep blue-grey finely patterned body, MANY PAIRS OF SHORT STUBBY UNJOINTED CONICAL LEGS along its entire length, two long flexible antennae and a soft matte skin
barrelsponge: A giant barrel sponge on a reef, an ENORMOUS LIVING MARINE SPONGE shaped like an open-topped barrel or vase, with a rough porous pitted reddish-brown surface and a deep hollow cavity opening at the top. A living sponge, absolutely NOT a wooden barrel with staves and metal hoops
seasquirt: A sea squirt, a simple sac-like marine invertebrate: a soft translucent bulbous tube attached to a rock, with TWO SHORT OPEN SIPHON TUBES at the top and a smooth rubbery orange-pink body. A simple sac-shaped animal, absolutely NOT humanoid, no arms, no legs, no face
villageweaver: A village weaver bird at its woven nest, a SMALL YELLOW BIRD with a black face mask, a bright yellow body, black and yellow patterned wings, a stout conical pale beak and small feet gripping a hanging woven grass nest. A small bird, absolutely NOT humanoid
rockdove: A rock dove pigeon standing, a plump grey pigeon with an IRIDESCENT GREEN AND PURPLE NECK, two dark bars across each wing, an orange eye, a small round head and pink feet
